name: Young Justice
description: Teenage superheroes strive to prove themselves as members of the Justice League.

credits_cast.character: M'gaan M'orzz / Megan Morse / Miss Martian (voice)
credits_cast.name: Danica McKellar

videos.title: Invasion: Behind the Scenes
videos.overview: A behind the scenes look at the second season with the producer and director of the series.

videos.title: The Prize
videos.overview: Conner Kent and Megan Morse bid farewell to their friends as they head off for a new adventure on their own, signaling the end of their time on the Team. What's more, Arsenal joins the Team once again, after an invitation from Artemis Crock.

videos.title: Independence Day (1)
videos.overview: Robin, Aqualad, and Kid Flash break into Cadmus and find that it is being run by Genomorphs.

videos.title: Fireworks (2)
videos.overview: The sidekicks find a clone of Superman known as Superboy. They free him from Cadmus' control, while battling Blockbuster.

videos.title: Welcome to Happy Harbor
videos.overview: After Speedy declines to join the new team, Robin, Aqualad and Kid Flash fear Young Justice is just a big joke…while new member Miss Martian fears there's no room for her to be part of it. So when the four heroes and Superboy come up against Mister Twister, it looks like all their fears have just been realized…

videos.title: Drop-Zone
videos.overview: Young Justice goes on its first official mission under Batman, while trying to determine which of them will lead the team.

videos.title: Schooled
videos.overview: Superboy's anger over his non-relationship with Superman is getting out of control. He refuses to train with Black Canary, and when the team faces an opponent that even the Justice League had trouble defeating, the Boy of Steel goes rogue.

videos.title: Infiltrator
videos.overview: Green Arrow's niece, Artemis, joins Young Justice and must save a bright young scientist from the League of Shadows.

videos.title: Denial
videos.overview: When the team investigates the disappearance of Kent Nelson (formerly Doctor Fate), the scientific-minded Wally West is forced to confront his disbelief in magic while battling Abra Kadabra and Klarion the Witch Boy, for the ultra-powerful Helmet of Fate.

videos.title: Downtime
videos.overview: After a disastrous mission with the team, Aqualad returns to Atlantis to choose between a life on the surface world or one beneath the waves with the Aquagirl of his dreams. But other forces at play may make Aqualad's decision for him.

videos.title: Bereft
videos.overview: Young Justice discovers that they have forgotten the last six months of their lives, including each other and a final fateful mission in Bialya. The team turns to Miss Martian to recover their memories, before it is too late for Superboy.

videos.title: Targets
videos.overview: Red Arrow is on his own against the world's most dangerous assassins in preventing the League of Shadows from starting a war, until he is forced to make an unlikely alliance with someone even more dangerous. Aqualad fails to convince Red Arrow to ask the team for help.

videos.title: Terrors
videos.overview: Superboy and Miss Martian go undercover inside Belle Reve Penitentiary.

videos.title: Homefront
videos.overview: When Mount Justice itself is attacked, can Artemis and Robin (the two teens without super-powers) save the Team (or even themselves) from the unknown invaders?

videos.title: Alpha Male
videos.overview: Already exhausted and rattled after a home turf invasion of The Cave, the team learns that Aqualad - their friend and leader - withheld vital information that put them all at risk. When Batman sends the Team and new "den-mother" Captain Marvel to India to investigate bizarre reports of armed animals attacking human beings, can Aqualad pull his fractured team together?

videos.title: Revelation
videos.overview: When Plant Creatures attack major cities around the world, the team is eager to join the fight alongside the Justice League. Instead, Batman assigns them a still more dangerous task - taking out the plants' masters: a secret society of super- villains: the Injustice League!

videos.title: Humanity
videos.overview: The team is on the hunt for Red Tornado, determined to find out once and for all whether the robot was the mole - even if it means kidnapping new friend Zatanna and dragging her along on their quest!

videos.title: Failsafe
videos.overview: When the Justice League is defeated during an alien invasion, the Team has to step up and fill their mentors shoes.

videos.title: Disordered
videos.overview: Superboy's "Sphere" goes through a surprising change, revealing a connection to the forever people of New Genesis.

videos.title: Secrets
videos.overview: It's Halloween. Artemis and Zatanna are in Manhattan for a girls' night out. There, they encounter the deadly Harm, who has a secret.

videos.title: Misplaced
videos.overview: When every adult on the planet disappears, only the team, Zatanna, and Billy Batson are left to defeat the five most powerful sorcerers on Earth. In the end, Zatanna officialy joins the team and Zatara becomes the new Doctor Fate.

videos.title: Coldhearted
videos.overview: Wally West comes oh-so-close to fulfilling his birthday wish to finally fight alongside the Justice League. Instead, a massively disappointed Kid Flash is taken off the mission and tasked with a simple delivery job. But a few deadly surprises await the birthday boy along the way.

videos.title: Image
videos.overview: A covert operation against Queen Bee in Qurac forces Miss Martian to finally face her greatest fears and her biggest secrets. But will she reveal those secrets to her friends—or allow what she's hiding to take down the entire team?

videos.title: Agendas
videos.overview: Superboy returns to Project Cadmus, where he learns the top-secret genetics lab may have created another Super-clone.

videos.title: Insecurity
videos.overview: Red Arrow's return undercuts Artemis' confidence, while the team's mission to track down Sportsmaster threatens to expose her darkest secrets.

videos.title: Performance
videos.overview: The Team goes undercover at the Haly International Traveling Circus to locate a thief stealing weapons technology across Europe. But a thief isn’t all they find…

videos.title: Usual Suspects
videos.overview: The Team gets a new member and a new mission – a mission that may finally expose all the Team’s secrets... and all their lies!

videos.title: Auld Acquaintance
videos.overview: The Team finally learns the identity of the traitor in their midst, forcing a battle against an enemy more dangerous than any they’ve ever faced before!

videos.title: Happy New Year
videos.overview: The Team takes on the intergalactic bounty hunter Lobo…as a precursor to an alien invasion!

videos.title: Earthlings
videos.overview: Miss Martian, Superboy, Beast Boy and Adam Strange arrive on the distant planet Rann to stop the alien infiltration of Earth at its source.

videos.title: Alienated
videos.overview: The Team and the Justice League continue to hunt the Kroloteans that have invaded Earth—but the aliens have help from an extremely unexpected source.

videos.title: Salvage
videos.overview: While Superboy and Blue Beetle battle Intergang, Nightwing and company try to salvage the soul of a former comrade fallen from grace.

videos.title: Beneath
videos.overview: Jaime Reyes searches for a missing friend, while Miss Martian, Batgirl, Bumblebee and Wonder Girl return to Bialya to discover what lies beneath.

videos.title: Bloodlines
videos.overview: An intruder mysteriously appears inside Mount Justice, claiming to be a tourist from the future. But who is he really? And what is his true agenda?

videos.title: Depths
videos.overview: Artemis rejoins the team to defend a critical satellite launch. But will her first mission back also be her last?!

videos.title: Satisfaction
videos.overview: Roy Harper seeks vengeance against the man who ruined his life.

videos.title: Darkest
videos.overview: Black Manta sends Kaldur on a mission that will prove where his loyalties truly lie.

videos.title: Before the Dawn
videos.overview: The Team uncovers some shocking secrets while on a covert rescue mission.

videos.title: Cornered
videos.overview: A brutal alien warrior traps the Team inside the Hall of Justice.

videos.title: True Colors
videos.overview: Robin leads a squad to investigate Lexcorp's troubling allegiances.

videos.title: The Fix
videos.overview: In revenge for her telepathic attack on his son, Black Manta goes after Miss Martian.

videos.title: Runaways
videos.overview: Nightwing tasks Blue Beetle with chasing down a group of potentially dangerous super-powered teenage runaways. But Blue Beetle is not the only one hunting them...

videos.title: War
videos.overview: A conqueror from another world becomes a wild card in an intergalactic game of supremacy -- placing planet Earth square in the jackpot.

videos.title: Complications
videos.overview: Black Manta gives Miss Martian twenty-four hours to live, but that may be more time than Aqualad has with Sportsmaster and Cheshire on the hunt for his head!

videos.title: The Hunt
videos.overview: A band of misfits is put to the test when Lex Luthor sends them behind enemy lines... to rescue the team!

videos.title: Intervention
videos.overview: The team embarks on a desperate endeavor to free Blue Beetle!!

videos.title: Summit
videos.overview: The Light calls a summit to decide the final fate of Aqualad, the team ... and the entire planet Earth!

videos.title: Endgame
videos.overview: On the verge of finally ending the alien invasion, the team discovers the price of victory may be the entire planet Earth!

videos.title: Princes All
videos.overview: After the Justice League faces a horrifying incident on the planet Rann, Dick Grayson gathers an elite squad of heroes to shut down a meta-human trafficking syndicate in Markovia.

videos.title: Royal We
videos.overview: Dick Grayson, Artemis Crock, Conner Kent and Jefferson Pierce go undercover in Markovia to stop the Bedlam Syndicate's meta-human trafficking cartel – before it claims another victim

videos.title: Eminent Threat
videos.overview: Conner Kent and Prince Biron Markov are in the clutches of Count Vertigo, leaving Dick Grayson, Artemis Crock and an emotionally damaged Jefferson Pierce to save them and put an end to the Bedlam Syndicate.

videos.title: Private Security
videos.overview: After the Justice League faces a horrifying incident on the planet Rann, Dick Grayson gathers an elite squad of heroes to shut down a meta-human trafficking syndicate in Markovia.

videos.title: Away Mission
videos.overview: Dick Grayson, Artemis Crock, Conner Kent and Jefferson Pierce go undercover in Markovia to stop the Bedlam Syndicate's meta-human trafficking cartel – before it claims another victim

videos.title: Rescue Op
videos.overview: Brion Markov is determined to rescue his missing sister – even if it means throwing down against the entire League of Shadows.

videos.title: Evolution
videos.overview: Aliens again threaten the Earth, but with the Justice League split and scattered, only the planet’s first and greatest hero can save the day.

videos.title: Triptych
videos.overview: As Meta-Human trafficking spreads across the United States, three very different teams of heroes hope to put a stop to it.

videos.title: Home Fires
videos.overview: The Light has hired an intergalactic assassin, but who is the intended target?!

videos.title: Exceptional Human Beings
videos.overview: The search for Tara Markov continues – but who’s doing the searching and where?!

videos.title: Another Freak
videos.overview: It’s the first day of school for Violet Harper and Forager. And the last day for a different freak…

videos.title: Nightmare Monkeys
videos.overview: Garfield Logan tests out a pair of Goode VR goggles. Then the goggles test him!

videos.title: True Heroes
videos.overview: Grayson’s operatives attempt to stop an auction of enslaved meta-teens.

videos.title: Influence
videos.overview: The team reassembles as the Justice League faces a new threat in space.

videos.title: Leverage
videos.overview: A new Gamma Squad team is sent out on its first mission to investigate rumors of meta-trafficking in Russia.

videos.title: Illusion of Control
videos.overview: Across the nation, the team members give thanks for what they have -- and for what they very well might lose.

videos.title: First Impression
videos.overview: The Reach are back, terrorizing small town America… unless the Outsiders can stop them!

videos.title: Early Warning
videos.overview: Project Rutabaga threatens to create an international crisis for the Outsiders.

videos.title: Elder Wisdom
videos.overview: The Outsiders face Lex Luthor's machinations, but Lex is not the only one trying to manipulate them.

videos.title: Quiet Conversations
videos.overview: Victor Stone reaches a crisis point -- but he's not the only one.

videos.title: Unknown Factors
videos.overview: Dick Grayson and Jefferson go after Gretchen Goode -- and they encounter the ominous Overlord.

videos.title: Antisocial Pathologies
videos.overview: The betrayals come fast and furious -- and with them is a reckoning.

videos.title: Terminus
videos.overview: The hunt for Halo is on.

videos.title: Into the Breach
videos.overview: The Outsiders make a final attempt to save Halo -- and the galaxy.

videos.title: Overwhelmed
videos.overview: Artemis and Conner journey back to their pasts during the calm before the storm.

videos.title: Nevermore
videos.overview: Things come full circle as the team and the Outsiders return to Markovia for a final confrontation.

videos.title: Inhospitable
videos.overview: Miss Martian, Superboy, Beast Boy, and Martian Manhunter take a little vacation...to somewhat unfriendly climes.

videos.title: Needful
videos.overview: While attempting to solve a growing list of mysteries, Miss Martian, Superboy, and Beast Boy consult with royalty.

videos.title: Volatile
videos.overview: Miss Martian and Superboy grapple with family traditions, while Beast Boy struggles with something much darker.

videos.title: Involuntary
videos.overview: Answers come to light as Beast Boy, Miss Martian, and Superboy uncover an awful truth.

videos.title: Tale of Two Sisters
videos.overview: Just as multiple Shadows fall across her path, Artemis Crock’s life is interrupted by devastating news.

videos.title: Artemis Through the Looking-Glass
videos.overview: Tigress catches up with her sister, Cheshire, as a Shadowed history catches up with them both.

videos.title: The Lady, or the Tigress?
videos.overview: Oracle’s memories challenge Tigress’ decision to trust her new allies.

videos.title: I Know Why the Caged Cat Sings
videos.overview: For Tigress, saving everyone may not be an option - unless help is offered from an unexpected source.

videos.title: Odnu!
videos.overview: Zatanna and her protégés find themselves on the brink of war.

videos.title: Nomed Esir!
videos.overview: Zatanna and her protégés encounter new allies…and an ancient foe.

videos.title: Teg Ydaer!
videos.overview: Thirteen and her friends face their greatest challenge yet.

videos.title: Og Htrof Dna Reuqnoc!
videos.overview: Zatanna must rally the Sentinels of Magic before Chaos consumes the Earth.

videos.title: Kaerb Ym Traeh!
videos.overview: Zatanna and the Sentinels of Magic gain unlikely allies – but will it be enough?

videos.title: Nautical Twilight
videos.overview: Kaldur’ahm chews algae, while Violet Harper cuts vegetables.

videos.title: Ebb Tide
videos.overview: While Clark Kent gets all the news that’s fit to print, Kaldur’ahm hears old family stories from his parents.

videos.title: Emergency Dive
videos.overview: Kaldur’ahm, Wyynde, and La’gann go for a swim. King Orin goes fishing.

videos.title: Leviathan Wakes
videos.overview: Kaldur’ahm searches… Atlantis finds.

videos.title: Beyond the Grip of the Gods!
videos.overview: Rocket gets a reality check… and reality’s ready to collect.

videos.title: Encounter Upon the Razor's Edge!
videos.overview: Rocket misses one conference… while another goes poorly.

videos.title: Forbidden Secrets of Civilizations Past!
videos.overview: Rocket learns the hard way that nothing stays buried forever.

videos.title: Odyssey of Death!
videos.overview: When one portal opens for Rocket, another closes… forever.

videos.title: Rescue and Search
videos.overview: Bart Allen goes shopping. Zatanna Zatara talks baseball. Plus, the return of Daring Dan Danger!

videos.title: Ego and Superego
videos.overview: After refurbishing an old bus, Nightwing and the gang hit the road.

videos.title: Zenith and Abyss
videos.overview: Team Trauma on Trombus!

videos.title: Over and Out
videos.overview: You can go home again… but beware of hitchhikers.

videos.title: Death and Rebirth
videos.overview: The very next final battle for the planet Earth...

awards: Won 1 Primetime Emmy. 9 wins & 30 nominations total
